items.title: Show HN: Story Keeper – AI agents with narrative continuity instead of memory
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN! Creator here.
I built Story Keeper to solve a problem I kept hitting with AI agents: they remember everything but lose coherence over long conversations.
The Core Idea
Instead of storing chat history and retrieving chunks (RAG approach), Story Keeper maintains a living narrative: Characters: Who you are (evolving), who the agent is
Arc: Where you started → where you're going
Themes: What matters to you
Context: The thread connecting everything Think of it as the difference between reading meeting notes vs. being in the relationship.
Technical Approach
~200 lines of Python. Three primitives: Story State (not message list)
Story Evolution (not appending)
Story-Grounded Response (not retrieval) Works with any LLM - tested with GPT-4, Claude, Llama 3.1, Mistral.

Tradition

Unlike previous language models that relied on vast data to "memorize" answers, Ring-1T aims to enable AI to genuinely "reason" out solutions to complex problems. excerpt_i18n.en:
On October 24, Tencent released the "2025 Tencent R&D Big Data Report," systematically disclosing its 2025 R&D progress for the first time. The report shows that AI has been fully integrated into Tencent's R&D system, becoming a new engine driving efficiency improvements. Over 90% of Tencent engineers use the AI programming assistant CodeBuddy for coding support, and 50% of new code is AI-assisted. By leveraging WeDev to streamline the R&D toolchain and connect processes, overall R&D efficiency has increased by over 20%.

In 2025, R&D personnel made up 76% of Tencent's workforce, meaning three out of every four employees were engaged in R&D. Tencent added an average of 325 million lines of new code monthly, completed 370,000 requirements per month, and executed 25.2 million builds and deliveries, supporting rapid business iteration.

With the support of its self-developed Hunyuan large model, AI has deeply penetrated coding, review, testing, and other stages. 50% of new code is AI-assisted, equivalent to one out of every two lines written by engineers being aided by AI. AI assistance has reduced average coding time by 40% and boosted overall R&D efficiency by over 20%.

In code reviews, AI participation reached 94%, meaning nearly every code submission at Tencent is pre-reviewed by an AI quality inspector before human engineers intervene, with 28% of code defects identified by AI.

El informe muestra que la IA se ha integrado completamente en el sistema de I+D de Tencent, convirtiéndose en un "nuevo motor" que impulsa la eficiencia en el desarrollo. Más del 90% de los ingenieros de Tencent utilizan el asistente de programación con IA CodeBuddy para apoyar la codificación, y el 50% del código nuevo se genera con asistencia de IA. Gracias a WeDev, se ha integrado la cadena de herramientas de eficiencia en I+D, conectando los procesos de desarrollo y logrando un aumento de más del 20% en la eficiencia general de I+D de la empresa. En 2025, el personal de I+D y producción de Tencent representa el 76% de la plantilla, es decir, 3 de cada 4 empleados de Tencent.

items.raw_excerpt: 10月23日，钛动科技主办的“钛动全球增长生态大会”在广州举行。现场汇聚了来自 Google、Meta、华为云、智谱AI、飞书等科技企业代表，以及香港科技大学、中山大学等学术机构专家，超过500位产业嘉宾共话AI Agent在全球商业增长中的落地与机遇。 大会最核心的发布，是钛动科技 CEO 李述昊 所提出的“AI 上班论”与“双引擎战略”——以 MarTech Multi-Agent 平台 Navos 与 全球增长大模型“钛极（Tec-Chi）” 共同构建智能化出海的新底座。 李述昊的判断直接而明确：2025年是AI应用元年。 在他看来，生成式AI的快速演进，意味着AI 已完成了“九年义务教育”，而当前阶段，是时候让它真正走入产业、走向岗位——AI要开始上班了。 钛动科技要解决的问题，正是让AI从“懂原理”到“懂业务”。 李述昊认为，大模型为AI提供了语言与认知的底座，但要让AI创造实质商业价值，需要让它掌握“本科级”的产业知识，比如品牌增长、跨境营销、消费者洞察等，这些正是钛动多年在出海生态积累的Know-how。 李述昊将这一转变比喻为“第四次产业革命”的核心。他表示，前三次产业革命释放了体力，AI革命释放的是脑力。 此次发布的“双引擎战略”，或许是钛动科技向AI驱动公司转型的关键节点。 Navos（取自 Navigation + OS）是钛动自研的 MarTech Multi-Agent 平台，旨在为企业提供全球出海导航。它整合了市场洞察、创意雷达、广告监控与数据报告四大模块，能够实时捕捉全球市场变化，分析爆款素材，监控多平台投放，并输出定制化报告，让AI成为企业的数字投手。 钛极（Tec-Chi） 则是一套面向出海营销场景的全球增长大模型。其名字源于“太极”的哲思：AI（阳）代表智能能力的显性输出，BI（阴）代表数据资产的隐性积累。两者合一，形成持续迭代的智能增长

Through intelligent agents enabling autonomous planning, the "Task Mode" supports generating reports and podcasts. Users can initiate tasks using natural language queries on the homepage or within the knowledge base and attach resources like knowledge bases, documents, images, audio, webpages, and notes, providing the large model with "reference materials" during task execution. For generating podcasts in audio format, it allows selecting the number of participants and voice tones, meeting deep information processing and creative needs in learning or work scenarios.

Once users activate "Task Mode," IMA autonomously breaks down and plans task steps using LLM, drawing on data from the entire web or the knowledge base. It utilizes tools such as in-depth content reading, web-wide searches, knowledge base queries, and content creation to fulfill user instructions, self-monitoring and correcting during execution to deliver directly usable outcomes. Examples include tasks like "help me write a report on the new energy vehicle market," "summarize key points from a meeting discussion and generate minutes," or "design a lesson on 'biology' for me."
